## tal-a15-p03

source_text: [and]-uktaṃ svacchandaśāstre ca śiṣyaṃ pṛcchedguruḥ svayam / phalaṃ prārthayase yādṛktādṛksādhanamārabhe vāsanābhedataḥ sādhyaprāptirmantrapracoditā / mantramudrādhvadravyāṇāṃ home sādhāraṇā sthitiḥ vāsanābhedato bhinnaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca guroḥ phalam / sādhako dvividhaḥ śaivadharmā lokojjhitasthitiḥ lokadharmī phalākāṃkṣī śubhasthaścāśubhojjhitaḥ / dvidhā mumukṣurnirbījaḥ samayādivivarjitaḥ bālabāliśavṛddhastrībhogabhugvyādhitādikaḥ / anyaḥ sabījo yasyetthaṃ dīkṣoktā śivaśāsane vidvaddvandvasahānāṃ tu sabījā samayātmikā / dīkṣānugrāhikā pālyā viśeṣasamayāstu taiḥ abhāvaṃ bhāvayetsamyakkarmaṇāṃ prācyabhāvinām / mumukṣornirapekṣasya prārabdhrekaṃ na śādhayet sādhakasya tu bhūtyarthamitthameva viśodhayet / śivadharmiṇyasau dīkṣā lokadharmāpahāriṇī adharmarūpiṇāmeva na śubhānāṃ tu śodhanam / lokadharmiṇyasau dīkṣā mantrārādhanavarjitā prārabdhadehabhede tu bhuṅkte@sāvaṇimādikam / bhuktvordhvaṃ yāti yatraiṣa yukto@tha sakale@kale

## tal-a15-p04

source_text: [and]-samayācārapāśaṃ tu nirbījāyāṃ viśodhayet / dīkṣāmātreṇa muktiḥ syādbhaktyā deve gurau sadā sadyonirvāṇadā seyaṃ nirbījā yeti bhaṇyate / atītānāgatārabdhapāśatrayaviyojikā dīkṣāvasāne śuddhasya dehatyāge paraṃ padam / dehatyāge sabījāyāṃ karmābhāvādvipadyate samayācārapāśaṃ tu dīkṣitaḥ pālayetsadā / evaṃ pṛṣṭvā parijñāya vicārya ca guruḥ svayam ucitāṃ saṃvidhitsustāṃ vāsanāṃ tādṛśīṃ śrayet / āyātaśaktipātasya dīkṣāṃ prati na daiśikaḥ avajñāṃ vidadhīteti śaṃbhunājñā nirūpitā / svadhanena daridrasya kuryāddīkṣāṃ guruḥ svayam api dūrvāmbubhiryadvā dīkṣāyai bhikṣate śiśuḥ / bhikṣopāttaṃ nijaṃ vātha dhanaṃ prāggurave śiśuḥ dadyādyena viśuddhaṃ tadyāgayogyatvamaśnute / tatrādau śivatāpattisvātantryāveśa eva yaḥ sa eva hi guruḥ kāryastato@sau dīkṣaṇe kṣamaḥ / śivatāveśitā cāsya bahūpāyā pradarśitā kramikā bāhyarūpā tu snānanyāsārcanādibhiḥ / bahvīṣu tāsu tāsveṣa kriyāsu śivatāṃ hṛdi

## tal-a15-p05

source_text: [and]-saṃdadhaddṛḍhamabhyeti śivabhāvaṃ prasannadhīḥ / śivībhūto yadyadicchettattatkartuṃ samīhate śivābhimānitopāyo bāhyo heturna mokṣadaḥ / śivo@yaṃ śiva evāsmītyevamācāryaśiṣyayoḥ hetutadvattayā dārḍhyābhimāno mocako hyaṇoḥ / nādhyātmena vinā bāhyaṃ nādhyātmaṃ bāhyavarjitam siddhyejjñānakriyābhyāṃ taddvitīyaṃ saṃprakāśate / śrībrahmayāmale deva iti tena nyarūpayat śrīmadānandaśāstre ca nāśuddhiḥ syādvipaścitaḥ / kintu snānaṃ suvastratvaṃ tuṣṭisaṃjananaṃ bhavet tatra prasiddhadehādimātṛnirmalatākramāt / ayatnato@ntarantaḥ syānnairmalya snāyatāṃ tataḥ snānaṃ ca devadevasya yanmūrtyaṣṭakamucyate / tatraivaṃ mantradīpte@ntarmaladāhe nimajjanam tatreṣṭamantrahṛdayo gorajo@ntaḥ padatrayam / gatvāgatya bhajetsnānaṃ pārthivaṃ dhṛtidāyakam astramantritamṛddhūtamalaḥ pañcāṅgamantritaiḥ / jalairmūrdhādipādāntaṃ kramādākṣālayettataḥ nimajjetsāṅgamūlākhyaṃ japannā tanmayatvataḥ / utthāyāśeṣasajjyotirdevatāgarbhamambare

## tal-a15-p07

source_text: [and]-iti snānāṣṭakaṃ śuddhāvuttarottaramuttamam / sarvatra paścāttaṃ mantramekībhūtamupāharet ghṛtyāpyāyamalaploṣavīryavyāptimṛjisthitīḥ / abhedaṃ ca kramādeti snānāṣṭakaparo muniḥ etā hyanugrahātmāno mūrtayo@ṣṭau śivātmikāḥ / svarūpaśivarūpābhyāṃ dhyānāttattatphalapradāḥ anena vidhinārcāyāṃ kandādhārādiyojanām / kurvanvyāsasamāsābhyāṃ dharādestatphalaṃ bhajet tathāhi yogasaṃcāre mantrāḥ syurbhuvi pārthivāḥ / āpye āpyā yāvadamī śive śivamayā iti śrīnirmaryādaśāstre@pi taditthaṃ sunirūpitam / dharādeśca viśeṣo@sti vīrasādhakasaṃmataḥ raṇareṇurvīrajalaṃ vīrabhasma mahāmarut / śmaśānāraṇyagaganaṃ candrārkau tadupāhitau ātmā nirdhūtaniḥśeṣavikalpātaṅkasusthitaḥ / snānārcādāvityupāsyaṃ vīrāṇāṃ vigrahāṣṭakam śrīmantriśirasi proktaṃ madyaśīdhusurādinā / susvādunā prasannena tanunā susugandhinā kandalādigatenāntarbahiḥ saṃskārapañcakam / kṛtvā nirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣya tāḍanāpyāyaguṇṭhanam

## tal-a15-p08

source_text: [and]-mantracakrasya tanmadhye pūjāṃ vipruṭpratarpaṇam / tenātmasekaḥ kalaśamudrayā cābhiṣecanam devatātarpaṇaṃ dehaprāṇobhayapathāśritam / sarvatīrthatapoyajñadānādi phalamaśnute madyasnāne sādhakendro mumukṣuḥ kevalībhavet / yataḥ śivamayaṃ madyaṃ sarve mantrāḥ śivodbhavāḥ śivaśaktyorna bhedo@sti śaktyutthāstu marīcayaḥ / tāsāmānandajanakaṃ madyaṃ śivamayaṃ tataḥ prabuddhe saṃvidaḥ pūrṇe rūpe@dhikṛtibhājanam / mantradhyānasamādhānabhedātsnānaṃ tu yanna tat yuktaṃ snānaṃ yato nyāsakarmādau yogyatāvaham / asya snānāṣṭakasyāsti bāhyāntaratayā dvitā āntaraṃ tadyathordhvendudhārāmṛtapariplavaḥ / yato randhrordhvagāḥ sārdhamaṅgulaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitāḥ mūrtayo@ṣṭāvapi proktāḥ pratyekaṃ dvādaśāntataḥ / eṣāmekatamaṃ snānaṃ kuryāddvitryādiśo@pivā iti snānavidhiḥ prokto bhairaveṇāmalīkṛtau / snānānantarakartavyamathedamupadiśyate bhāvaṃ prasannamālocya vrajedyāgagṛhaṃ tataḥ / parvatāgranadītīraikaliṅgādi yaducyate

## tal-a15-p09

source_text: [and]-tadbāhyamiha tatsiddhiviśeṣāya na muktaye / ābhyantaraṃ nagāgrādi dehāntaḥ prāṇayojanam sādhakānāmupāyaḥ syātsiddhaye natu muktaye / pīṭhasthānaṃ sadā yāgayogyaṃ śāstreṣu bhaṇyate tacca bāhyāntarādrūpādbahirdehe ca susphuṭam / yataḥ śrīnaiśasañcāre parameśo nyarūpayat tasyecchā pīṭhamādhāro yatrasthaṃ sacarācaram / agryaṃ tatkāmarūpaṃ syādbindunādadvayaṃ tataḥ nādapīṭhaṃ pūrṇagirirdakṣiṇe vāmataḥ punaḥ / pīṭhamuḍḍayanaṃ bindurmukhyaṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ tvidam jñeyaṃ saṃkalpanārūpamardhapīṭhamataḥ param / śāktaṃ kuṇḍalinī vedakalaṃ ca tryupapīṭhakam devīkoṭṭojjayinyau dve tathā kulagiriḥ paraḥ / lālanaṃ baindavaṃ vyāptiriti saṃdohakatrayam puṇḍravardhanavārendre tathaikāmramidaṃ bahiḥ / navadhā kathitaṃ pīṭhamantarbāhyakrameṇa tat kṣetrāṣṭakaṃ kṣetravido hṛdambhojadalāṣṭakam / prayāgo varaṇā paścādaṭṭahāso jayantikā vārāṇasī ca kāliṅgaṃ kulūtā lāhulā tathā / upakṣetrāṣṭakaṃ prāhurhṛtpadmāgradalāṣṭakam

## tal-a15-p10

source_text: [and]-virajairuḍikā hālā elā pūḥ kṣīrikā purī / māyākhyā marudeśaśca bāhyābhyantararūpataḥ hṛtpadmadalasandhīnāmupasaṃdohakāṣṭatā / jālandharaṃ ca naipālaṃ kaśmīrā gargikā haraḥ mlecchadigdvāravṛttiśca kurukṣetraṃ ca kheṭakam / dvipathaṃ dvayasaṃghaṭṭāttripathaṃ trayamelakāt catuṣpathaṃ śaktimato layāttatraiva manvate / nāsāntatālurandhrāntametaddehe vyavasthitam bhrūmadhyakaṇṭhahṛtsaṃjñaṃ madhyamaṃ tadudāhṛtam / nābhikandamahānandadhāma tatkaulikaṃ trayam parvatāgraṃ nadītīramekaliṅgaṃ tadeva ca / kiṃ vātibahunā sarvaṃ saṃvittau prāṇagaṃ tataḥ tato dehasthitaṃ tasmāddehāyatanago bhavet / bāhye tu tādṛśāntaḥsthayogamārgaviśāradāḥ devyaḥ svabhāvājjāyante pīṭhaṃ tadvāhyamucyate / yathā svabhāvato mlecchā adharmapathavartinaḥ tatra deśe niyatyetthaṃ jñānayogau sthitau kvacit / yathācātanmayo@pyeti pāpitāṃ taiḥ samāgamāt tathā pīṭhasthito@pyeti jñānayogādipātratām / mukhyatvena śarīre@ntaḥ prāṇe saṃvidi paśyataḥ

virajairuḍikā hālā elā pūḥ kṣīrikā purī / māyākhyā marudeśaśca bāhyābhyantararūpataḥ hṛtpadmadalasandhīnāmupasaṃdohakāṣṭatā / jālandharaṃ ca naipālaṃ kaśmīrā gargikā haraḥ mlecchadigdvāravṛttiśca kurukṣetraṃ ca kheṭakam / dvipathaṃ dvayasaṃghaṭṭāttripathaṃ trayamelakāt catuṣpathaṃ śaktimato layāttatraiva manvate / nāsāntatālurandhrāntametaddehe vyavasthitam bhrūmadhyakaṇṭhahṛtsaṃjñaṃ madhyamaṃ tadudāhṛtam / nābhikandamahānandadhāma tatkaulikaṃ trayam parvatāgraṃ nadītīramekaliṅgaṃ tadeva ca / kiṃ vātibahunā sarvaṃ saṃvittau prāṇagaṃ tataḥ tato dehasthitaṃ tasmāddehāyatanago bhavet / bāhye tu tādṛśāntaḥsthayogamārgaviśāradāḥ devyaḥ svabhāvājjāyante pīṭhaṃ tadvāhyamucyate / yathā svabhāvato mlecchā adharmapathavartinaḥ tatra deśe niyatyetthaṃ jñānayogau sthitau kvacit / yathācātanmayo@pyeti pāpitāṃ taiḥ samāgamāt tathā pīṭhasthito@pyeti jñānayogādipātratām / mukhyatvena śarīre@ntaḥ prāṇe saṃvidi paśyataḥ

## tal-a15-p11

source_text: [and]-viśvametatkimanyaiḥ syādbahirbhramaṇaḍambaraiḥ / ityevamantarbāhye ca tattaccakraphalārthinām sthānabhedo vicitraśca sa śāstre saṃkhyayojjhitaḥ / śrīvīrāvalihṛdaye sapta sthānāni śaktikamalayugam surapathacatuṣpathākhyaśmaśānamekāntaśūnyavṛkṣau ca / iti nirvacanaguṇasthityupacāradṛśā vibodha evoktaḥ tadadhiṣṭhite ca cakre śārīre bahiratho bhavedyāgaḥ / muktaye tanna yāgasya sthānabhedaḥ prakalpyate deśopāyā na sā yasmātsā hi bhāvaprasādataḥ / uktaṃ ca śrīniśācāre siddhisādhanakāṅkṣiṇām sthānaṃ mumukṣuṇā tyājyaṃ sarpakañcukavattvidam / muktirna sthānajanitā yadā śrotrapathaṃ gatam gurostattvaṃ tadā muktistaddārḍhyāya tu pūjanam / yatra yatra hṛdambhojaṃ vikāsaṃ pratipadyate tatraiva dhāmni bāhye@ntaryāgaśrīḥ pratitiṣṭhati / nānyatragatyā mokṣo@sti so@jñānagranthikartanāt tacca saṃvidvikāsena śrīmadvīrāvalīpade / guravastu vimuktau vā siddhau vā vimalā matiḥ heturityubhayatrāpi yāgauko yanmanoramam / niyatiprāṇatāyogātsāmagrītastu yadyapi

## tal-a15-p12

source_text: [and]-siddhayo bhāvavaimalyaṃ tathāpi nikhilottamam / vimalībhūtahṛdayo yattatra pratibimbayet sādhyaṃ tadasya dārḍhyena saphalatvāya kalpate / uktaṃ śrīsāraśāstre ca nirvikalpo hi sidhyati kliśyante savikalpāstu kalpokte@pi kṛte sati / tadākramya balaṃ mantrā ayamevodayaḥ sphuṭaḥ ityādibhiḥ spandavākyairetadeva nirūpitam / tasmātsiddhyai vimuktyai vā pūjājapasamādhiṣu tatsthānaṃ yatra viśrāntisundaraṃ hṛdayaṃ bhavet / yāgaukaḥ prāpya śuddhātmā bahireva vyavasthitaḥ nyāsaṃ sāmānyataḥ kuryādbahiryāgaprasiddhaye / mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha dvitayaṃ vā kramākramāt sṛṣṭyapyayadvayaiḥ kuryādekaikaṃ saṃghaśo dviśaḥ / lalāṭavaktre dṛkkarṇanāsāgaṇḍaradauṣṭhage dvaye dvaye śikhājihve visargāntāstu ṣoḍaśa / dakṣānyayoḥ skandhabāhukarāṅgulinakhe kacau vargau ṭatau kramātkaṭyāmūrvādiṣu niyojayet / pavargaṃ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe jaṭhare hṛdyatho nava tvagraktamāṃsasūtrāsthivasāśukrapurogamān / ityeṣa mātṛkānyāso mālinyāstu nirūpyate

## tal-a15-p13

source_text: [and]-na śikhā ṛ ṝ ḷ ḷḷ ca śiromālā tha mastakam / netrāṇi cordhve dho@nye ī ghrāṇaṃ mudre ṇu ṇū śrutī bakavarga+i+ā vaktradantajihvāgiri kramāt / vabhayāḥ kaṇṭhadakṣādiskandhayorbhujayorḍaḍhau ṭho hastayorjhañau śākhā jraṭau śūlakapālake / pa hṛcchalau stanau kṣīramā sa jīvo visargayuk prāṇo havarṇaḥ kathitaḥ ṣakṣāvudaranābhigau / maśāntā kaṭiguhyoruyugmagā jānunī tathā eaikārau tatparau tu jaṅghe caraṇagau daphau / ityeṣā mālinī devī śaktimatkṣobhitā yataḥ kṛtyāveśāttataḥ śāktī tanuḥ sā paramārthataḥ / anyonyaṃ bījayonīnāṃ kṣobhādvaisargikodayāt kāṃ kāṃ siddhiṃ na vitaretkiṃ vā nyūnaṃ na pūrayet / yonibījārṇasāṃkaryaṃ bahudhā yadyapi sthitam tathāpi nādiphānto@yaṃ kramo mukhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / phakārādisamuccārānnakārānte@dhvamaṇḍalam saṃhṛtya saṃvidyā pūrṇā sā śabdairvarṇyate katham / ataḥ śāstreṣu bahudhā kulaputtalikādibhiḥ bhedairgītā hi mukhyeyaṃ nādiphānteti mālinī / śabdarāśerbhairavasya yānucchūnatayāntarī

## tal-a15-p14

source_text: [and]-sā māteva bhaviṣyattvāttenāsau mātṛkoditā / mālinī mālitā rudrairdhārikā siddhimokṣayoḥ phaleṣu puṣpitā pūjyā saṃhāradhvaniṣaṭpadī / saṃhāradānādānādiśaktiyuktā yato ralau ekatvena smarantīti śaṃbhunātho nirūcivān / śabdarāśirmālinī ca śivaśaktyātmakaṃ tvidam ekaikatrāpi pūrṇatvācchivaśaktisvabhāvatā / tena bhraṣṭe vidhau vīrye svarūpe vānayā param mantrā nyastāḥ punarnyāsātpūryante tatphalapradāḥ / uktaṃ śrīpūrvatantre ca viśeṣavidhihīnite nyasyecchāktaśarīrārthaṃ bhinnayoni tu mālinīm / viśeṣaṇamidaṃ hetau hetvarthaśca nirūpitaḥ yatheṣṭaphalasiddhyai cetyatraivedamabhāṣata / sāñjanā api ye mantrā gāruḍādyā na te param mālinyā pūritāḥ sidhdyai balādeva tu muktaye / tasmātphalepsurapyanya mantraṃ nyasyātra mālinīm nyasyejjaptvāpica japedayatnādapavṛktaye / ityevaṃ mātṛkāṃ nyasyenmālinīṃ vā kramāddvayam siddhimuktyanusārādvā varṇānvā yugapaddvayoḥ / akṣahrīṃ naphahrīmetau piṇḍau saṃghāvihānayoḥ

## tal-a15-p15

## tal-a15-p16

source_text: [and]-tathaikyābhyāsaniṣṭhasyākramādviśvamidaṃ haṭhāt / saṃpūrṇaśivatākṣobhanarīnartadiva sphuret uvāca pūjanastotre hyasmākaṃ paramo guruḥ / aho svādurasaḥ ko@pi śivapūjāmayotsavaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśato@pi tattvānāṃ kṣobho yatrollasatyalam / tadetādṛkpūrṇaśivaviśvāveśāya ye@rcanam kurvanti te śivā eva tānpūrṇānprati kiṃ phalam / vināpi jñānayogābhyāṃ kriyā nyāsārcanādikā itthamaikyasamāpattidānātparaphalapradā / sādhakasyāpi tatsadvipradamantraikatāṃ gatam viśvaṃ vrajadavighnatvaṃ svāṃ siddhiṃ śīghramāvahet / uktaṃ ca parameśena na vidhirnārcanakramaḥ kevalaṃ smaraṇātsiddhirvāñchiteti matādiṣu / tadevaṃ tanmayībhāvadāyinyarcākriyā yataḥ samastakārakaikātmyaṃ tenāsyāḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ / yaṣṭrādhārasya tādātmyaṃ sthānaśuddhividhikramāt yaṣṭṛyājyatadādhārakaraṇādānasaṃpradāḥ / nyāsakrameṇa śivatātādātmyamadhiśerate arghapātramapādānaṃ tasmādādīyate yataḥ / yacca tatsthaṃ jalādyetatkaraṇaṃ śodhane@rcane

## tal-a15-p17

source_text: [and]-arghapātrāmbuvipruḍbhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ hi śudhyati / śivārkakarasaṃsparśātkānyā śuddhirbhaviṣyati ūce śrīpūrvaśāstre tadarghapātravidhau vibhuḥ / na cāsaṃśodhitaṃ vastu kiṃcidapyupakalpayet tena śuddhaṃ tu sarvaṃ yadaśuddhamapi tacchuci / aśuddhatā ca vijñeyā paśutacchāsanāśayāt svatādavasthyātpūrvasmādathavāpyupakalpitāt / tena yadyadihāsannaṃ saṃvidaścidanugrahāt kiyato@pi tadatyantaṃ yogyaṃ yāge@tra jīvavat / anena nayayogena yadāsattividūrate saṃvideti tadā tatra yogyāyogyatvamādiśet / vīrāṇāmata eveha mithaḥ svapratimāmṛtam tattadyāgavidhāviṣṭaṃ gurubhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ / unmajjayati nirmagnāṃ saṃvidaṃ yattu suṣṭhu tat arcāyai yogyamānando yasmādunmagnatā citaḥ / tenācidrūpadehādiprādhānyavinimajjakam ānandajananaṃ pūjāyogyaṃ hṛdayahāri yat / ataḥ kulakramottīrṇatrikasāramatādiṣu madyakādambarīśīdhudravyādermahimā param / lokasthitiṃ racayituṃ madyādeḥ paśuśāsane

## tal-a15-p18

source_text: [and]-proktā hyaśuddhistatraiva tasya kvāpi viśuddhatā / pañcagavye pavitratvaṃ somacarṇanapātrayoḥ vidhiścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ haste kṛṣṇaviṣāṇitā / na patnyā ca vinā yāgaḥ sarvadaivatatulyatā surāhutirbrahmasatre vapāntrahṛdayāhutiḥ / pāśaveṣvapi śāstreṣu tadadarśi maheśinā ghorāndhyahaimananiśāmadhyagāciradīptivat / bhakṣyo haṃso na bhakṣyo@sāviti ripratipattiṣu smārtīṣu vijayatyeko yaḥ śivābhedaśuddhikaḥ / ajñatvavedādarśitvarāgadveṣādayo hyamī munīnāṃ vacasi svasminprāmāṇyonmūlanakṣamāḥ / vede@pi yadabhakṣyaṃ tadbhakṣyamityupadiśyate na vidhipratiṣedhākhyadharmayorekamāspadam / atha tatra na tadbhakṣyaṃ tadā tena tathā tataḥ evaṃ viṣayabhedānno śivokterbādhikā śrutiḥ / kvacidviṣayatulyatvādbādhyabādhakatā yadi tadbādhyā śrutireveti prāgevaitannirūpitam / prakṛtaṃ brūmahe kṛtvā nyāsaṃ dehārghapātrayoḥ sāmānyamarghapātrāmbhovipruḍbhiḥ prokṣya cākhilam / yāgopakaraṇaṃ paścādbāhyayāgaṃ samācaret

## tal-a15-p19

source_text: [and]-prabhāmaṇḍalake khe vā suliptāyāṃ ca vā bhuvi / triśūlārkavṛṣāndikasthā mātaraḥ kṣetrapaṃ yajet yoginīśca pṛthaṅmantrairoṃnamonāmayojitaiḥ / ekoccāreṇa vā bāhyaparivāretiśabditāḥ tāro nāma caturthyantaṃ namaścetyarcane manuḥ / evaṃ bahiḥ pūjayitvā dvāraṃ prokṣya prapūjayet triśiraḥśāsanādau ca sa dṛṣṭo vidhirucyate / gaṇeśalakṣmyau dvārordhve dakṣe vāme tayoḥ punaḥ madhye vāgīśvarīṃ diṇḍimahodarayugaṃ tathā / kramātsvadakṣavāmasthaṃ tathaitena krameṇa ca ekaikaṃ pūjayetsamyaṅ nandikālau trimārgagām / kālindīṃ chāgameṣāsyau svadakṣāddvāḥsthaśākhayoḥ adhodehalyananteśādhāraśaktīśca pūjayet / dvāramadhye sarasvatyā mahāstraṃ pūjayedamī padmādhāragatāḥ sarve@pyuditā vighnanāśakāḥ / pūjane pūrvavanmantro dīpakadvayakalpitaḥ arghapuṣpasamālambhadhūpanaivedyavandanaiḥ / pūjāṃ kuryādihārghaścāpyuttamadravyayojitaḥ ekoccāreṇa vā kuryāddvāḥsthadaivatapūjanam / rahasyapūjāṃ cetkuryāttadbāhyaparivārakam

## tal-a15-p21

source_text: [and]-tatprakāśitameyendusparśasaumyaṃ tadeva hi / evamāśācatuṣke@sminmadhyaviśrāntiyogataḥ catuṣkamanyattenāṣṭau diśastattadadhiṣṭhitāḥ / evaṃ prakāśamātre@sminvarade parame śive digvibhāgaḥ sthito loke śāstre@pica tathocyate / kramātsadāśivādhīśaḥ pañcamantratanuryataḥ īśanraghoravāmākhyasadyo@dhobhedato diśaḥ / īśa ūrdhvaṃ prakāśatvātpūrvaṃ vaktraṃ prasāri yat puruṣo dakṣiṇācaṇḍo vāmā vāmastu saumyakaḥ / parāṅmukhatayā sadyaḥ paścimā paribhāṣyate pātālavaktramadharamaprakāśatayā sthiteḥ / khamarudvahnijalabhūkhāni vaktrāṇyamuṣya hi mukhyatvena khamevordhvaṃ prakāśamayamucyate / tadeva mukhyato@dhastādaprakāśaṃ yataḥ sphuṭam madhye tu yatprakāśaṃ tanna prakāśyaṃ na cetarat / prakāśatvāddiśyamānamato@smindikcatuṣṭayam pañcamantratanurnātha itthaṃ viśvadigīśvaraḥ / tato@pīśastathā rudro viṣṇurbrahmā tathā sthitaḥ ūrdhvābhivyaktyayogyatvādviṣṇordhātuśca pañcamam / na vaktraṃ tau bhedamayau sṛṣṭisthitiprabhū yataḥ

## tal-a15-p22

source_text: [and]-digvibhāgastu tajjo@sti vadanānāṃ catuṣṭayāt / pañcamasya yujitve tau parityaktanijātmakau tato brahmāṇḍamadhye@pi jñānaśaktirvibho raviḥ / diśāṃ vibhāgaṃ kurute prakāśaghanavṛttimān tathāhi viṣuvadyoge yataḥ pūrvaṃ pradṛśyate / tatpūrva yatra tacchāyā tatpaścimamudāhṛtam tasmiñjigamiṣorasya yatsavyaṃ tattu dakṣiṇam / tatraiṣa caṇḍatejobhirbhāti jājvalyamānavat tatpurovarti vāmaṃ tu tadbhāsā khacitaṃ manāk / tata eva hi somyaṃ tannacāpi hyaprakāśakam yatrāsāvastamabhyeti tatpaścimamiti sthitiḥ / tatraiva paścime yeṣāṃ prākprakāśāvalokanam tadeva pūrvameteṣāṃ yathādhvani nirūpitam / sā sā dikca tathā tasya phaladāpi viparyaye vicitre phalasaṃpattiḥ prakāśādhīnikā yataḥ / itthaṃ sūryāśrayā diksyātsā vicitrāpi tādṛśī adhiṣṭhitā maheśena citratadrūpadhāriṇā / kiṃ vātibahunā yo@sau yaṣṭā tatsaṃmukhāditaḥ diśo@pi pravibhajyante prāksavyottarapaścimāḥ / svānusārakṛtaṃ taṃ ca digvibhāgaṃ sadā śivaḥ

## tal-a15-p23

source_text: [and]-adhitiṣṭhatyarkamiva sa vicitravapuryataḥ / svotthā api diśaḥ sveśāḥ śakrādyā hyadhiśerate te hi prakāśaśaktyaṃśāḥ prakāśānuvidhāyinaḥ / prakāśasya yadaiśvaryaṃ sa indro yattu tanmahaḥ so@gniryantṛtvabhīmatve yamo rakṣastadūnimā / prakāśyaṃ varuṇastacca cāñcalyādvāyurucyate bhāvasañcayayogena vitteśastatkṣaye vibhuḥ / adṛṣṭavigraho@nanto brahmordhve vṛṃhako vibhuḥ prakāśasyaiva śaktyaṃśā lokapāstena kīrtitāḥ / itthaṃ svādhīnarūpāpi diksaurī tūpadiśyate tatra sarvo hi niṣkampaṃ prakāśatvaṃ prapadyate / sarvago@pyanilo yadvadvyajanenopavījitaḥ prabuddhaḥ svāṃ kriyāṃ kuryāddharmanirṇodanādikām / tadvatsarvagatāḥ sarvā aindyādyāḥ śaktayaḥ sphuṭam sādhakāśvāsasaṃbuddhāstattatsveṣṭaphalapradāḥ / evaṃ saurī digīśānabrahmaviṣṇvīśasauśivaiḥ adhiṣṭhitā samāśvāsadārḍhyāttattatphalapradā / sādhako yacca vā kṣetraṃ maṇḍalaṃ veśma vā bhajet sthitastadanusāreṇa madhyībhavati śaṃkaraḥ / sa hi sarvamadhiṣṭhātā mādhyasthyeneti tasya yaḥ

## tal-a15-p24

## tal-a15-p25

source_text: [and]-tritattvanyāsatā cāsya pṛṣṭhe kakṣyātrayāgate / tato@ghorāṣṭakanyāsaḥ śirastaccaraṇātmakam tato@pi śivasadbhāvanyāsaḥ svāṃgasya saṃyutaḥ / ittha kṛte pañcake@sminyattanmukhyatayā bhavet upāsyamarcyaṃ tatsāṅgaṃ ṣaṣṭhe nyāse niyojayet / tenātra nyāsayogyo@sau bhagavānratiśekharaḥ ūrdhve nyāsyo navākhyasya mukhyatve@nyonyadhāmatā / evaṃ bhairavasadbhāvanāthe mukhyatayā yadi upāsyatā tattatsthāna prāṅnyāsyo ratiśekharaḥ / itthaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre me saṃpradāyaṃ nyarūpayat śaṃbhunātho nyāsavidhau devo hi kathamanyathā / nyāsa vivarjyate@muṣminnaṅgānyapyasya santi hi mūrtiḥ sṛṣṭistritattvaṃ cetyaṣṭau mūrtyaṅgasaṃyutāḥ / śivaḥ sāṅgaśca vijñeyo nyāsaḥ ṣoḍhā prakīrtitaḥ asyopari tataḥ śāktaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryācca ṣaḍvidham / parāparāṃ savaktrāṃ prāktataḥ prāgiti mālinīm paścātparāditritayaṃ śikhāhṛtpādagaṃ kramāt / tataḥ kavaktrakaṇṭheṣu hṛnnābhīguhya+ūrutaḥ jānupāde@pyaghoryādyaṃ tato vidyāṅgapañcakam / tatastvāvāhayecchaktiṃ mātṛsadbhāvarūpiṇīm

## tal-a15-p26

source_text: [and]-yogeśvarīṃ parāṃ pūrṇāṃ kālasaṃkarṣiṇīṃ dhruvām / aṅgavaktraparīvāraśaktidvādaśakādhikām sādhyānuṣṭhānabhedena nyāsakāle smaredguruḥ / paraiva devītritayamadhye yābhedinī sthitā sānavacchedacinmātrasadbhāveyaṃ prakīrtitā / sāraśāstre yāmale ca devyāstena prakīrtitaḥ mūrtiḥ savaktrā śaktiśca śaktitrayamathāṣṭakam / pañcāṅgāni parā śaktirnyāsaḥ śākto@pi ṣaḍvidhaḥ yāmalo@yaṃ mahānyāsaḥ siddhimuktiphalapradaḥ / muktyekārthī punaḥ pūrvaṃ śāktaṃ nyāsaṃ samācaret guravastvāhuritthaṃ yannyāsadvayamudāhṛtam / mumukṣuṇā tu pādādi tatkāryaṃ saṃhṛtikramāt yāvantaḥ kīrtitā bhedāḥ śaṃbhuśaktyaṇuvācakāḥ / tāvatsvapyeṣu mantreṣu nyāsaḥ ṣoḍhaiva kīrtitaḥ kiṃtvāvāhyastu yo mantraḥ sa tatrāṅgasamanvitaḥ / ṣaṣṭhaḥ syāditi sarvatra ṣoḍhaivāyamudāhṛtaḥ mudrāpradarśanaṃ paścātkāyena manasā girā / pañcāvasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyanuttaranāmikā ṣaṭkāraṇaṣaḍātmatvātṣaṭtriṃśattattvayojanam / evaṃ ṣoḍhāmahānyāse kṛte viśvamidaṃ haṭhāt

## tal-a15-p27

source_text: [and]-dehe tādātmyamāpannaṃ śuddhāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ prakāśayet / mūrtinyāsātsamārabhya yā sṛṣṭiḥ prasṛtātra sā abhedamānīya kṛtā śuddhā nyāsabalakramāt / tena ye@codayanmūḍhāḥ pāśadāhavidhūnane kṛte śānte śive rūḍhaḥ punaḥ kimavarohati / iti te dūrato dhvastāḥ paramārthaṃ hi śāṃbhavam na vidusta svasaṃvittisphurattāsāravarjitāḥ / na khalveṣa śivaḥ śānto nāma kaścidvibhedavān sarvetarādhvavyāvṛtto ghaṭatulyo@sti kutracit / mahāprakāśarūpā hi yeyaṃ saṃvidvijṛmbhate sa śivaḥ śivataivāsya vaiśvarūpyāvabhāsitā / tathābhāsanayogo@taḥ svarasenāsya jṛmbhate bhāsyamāno@tra cābhedaḥ svātmano bheda eva ca / bhede vijṛmbhite māyā māyāmāturvijṛmbhate abhede jṛmbhate@syaiva māyāmātuḥ śivātmatā / māyāpramātā tadrūpavikalpābhyāsapāṭavāt śiva eva tadabhyāsaphalaṃ nyāsādi kīrtitam / yathāhi duṣṭakarmāsmītyevaṃ bhāvayatastathā tathā śivo@haṃ nānyo@smītyevaṃ bhāvayatastathā / etadevocyate dārḍhyaṃ vimarśahṛdayaṅgamam

## tal-a15-p28

source_text: [and]-śivaikātmyavikalpaughadvārikā nirvikalpatā / anyathā tasya śuddhasya vimarśaprāṇavartinaḥ kathaṃ nāmāvimṛṣṭaṃ syādrūpaṃ bhāsanadharmaṇaḥ / tenātidurghaṭaghaṭāsvatantrecchāvaśādayam bhānapi prāṇabuddhyādiḥ svaṃ tathā na vikalpayet / pratyutātisvatantrātmaviparītasvadharmatām vināśyanīśāyattatvarūpāṃ niścitya majjati / tataḥ saṃsārabhāgīyatathāniścayaśātinīm nityādiniścayadvārāmavikalpāṃ sthitiṃ śrayet / ye tu tīvratamodriktaśaktinirmalatājuṣaḥ na te dīkṣāmanunyāsakāriṇaśceti varṇitam / evaṃ viśvaśarīraḥ sanviśvātmatvaṃ gataḥ sphuṭam nyāsamātrāt tathābhūtaṃ dehaṃ puṣpādinārcayet / pṛthaṅmantrairvistareṇa saṃkṣepānmūlamantrataḥ dhūpanaivedyatṛptyādyaistathā vyāsasamāsataḥ / saṃsāravāmācāratvātsarvaṃ vāmakareṇa tu kuryāttarpaṇayogaṃ ca daiśikastadanāmayā / vāmaśabdena guhyaṃ śrīmataṅgādāvapīritam vāmācāraparo mantrī yāgaṃ kuryāditi sphuṭam / śrīmadbhargaśikhāśāstre tathā śrīgamaśāsane

## tal-a15-p29 (15.281-15.290)
literal_gloss:
śivaikātmyavikalpaughadvārikā nirvikalpatā / anyathā tasya śuddhasya vimarśaprāṇavartinaḥ kathaṃ nāmāvimṛṣṭaṃ syādrūpaṃ bhāsanadharmaṇaḥ / tenātidurghaṭaghaṭāsvatantrecchāvaśādayam bhānapi prāṇabuddhyādiḥ svaṃ tathā na vikalpayet / pratyutātisvatantrātmaviparītasvadharmatām vināśyanīśāyattatvarūpāṃ niścitya majjati / tataḥ saṃsārabhāgīyatathāniścayaśātinīm nityādiniścayadvārāmavikalpāṃ sthitiṃ śrayet / ye tu tīvratamodriktaśaktinirmalatājuṣaḥ na te dīkṣāmanunyāsakāriṇaśceti varṇitam / evaṃ viśvaśarīraḥ sanviśvātmatvaṃ gataḥ sphuṭam nyāsamātrāt tathābhūtaṃ dehaṃ puṣpādinārcayet / pṛthaṅmantrairvistareṇa saṃkṣepānmūlamantrataḥ dhūpanaivedyatṛptyādyaistathā vyāsasamāsataḥ / saṃsāravāmācāratvātsarvaṃ vāmakareṇa tu kuryāttarpaṇayogaṃ ca daiśikastadanāmayā / vāmaśabdena guhyaṃ śrīmataṅgādāvapīritam vāmācāraparo mantrī yāgaṃ kuryāditi sphuṭam / śrīmadbhargaśikhāśāstre tathā śrīgamaśāsane

## tal-a15-p29

source_text: [and]-sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam / tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitamanāmātarpaṇātpriye śrīmannandiśikhāyāṃ ca śrīmadānandaśāsane / taduktaṃ srukca pūrṇāyāṃ sruvaśvājyāhutau bhavet śeṣaṃ vāmakareṇaiva pūjāhomajapādikam / evamānandasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvaunmukhyavivarjitam yāgena dehaṃ miṣpādya bhāvayeta śivātmakam / galite viṣayaunmukhye pārimitye vilāpite dehe kimavaśiṣyeta śivānandarasādṛte / śivānandarasāpūrṇaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvanirbharam dehaṃ divāniśaṃ paśyannarcayansyācchivātmakaḥ / viśvātmadehaviśrāntitṛptastalliṅganiṣṭhitaḥ bāhyaṃ liṅgavratakṣetracaryādi nahi vāñchati / tāvanmātrāttvaviśrānteḥ saṃvidaḥ kathitāḥ kriyāḥ uttarā bāhyayāgāntāḥ sādhyā tvatra śivātmatā / tato@rghapātraṃ kartavyaṃ śivābhedamayaṃ param ānandarasasaṃpūrṇaṃ viśvadaivatatarpaṇam / yathaiva dehe dāhādipūjāntaṃ tadvadeva hi arghapātre@pi kartavyaṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ / kāni dravyāṇi yāgāya ko nvargha iti noditam

## tal-a15-p30

source_text: [and]-siddhikāmasya tatsiddhau sādhanaiva hi kāraṇam / muktikāmasya no kiṃcinniṣiddhaṃ vihitaṃ ca no yadeva hṛdyaṃ tadyogyaṃ śivasaṃvidabhedane / kṛtvārghapātraṃ tadvipruṭprokṣitaṃ kusumādikam kṛtvā ca tena svātmānaṃ pūjayetparamaṃ śivam / arghapātrārcanādattapuṣpasaṃkīrṇatābhayāt nārghapātre@tra kusumaṃ kuryāddevārcanākṛte / arghapātre tadamṛtībhūtamambveva pūjitam mantrāṇāṃ tṛptaye yāgadravyaśuddhyai ca kevalam / evaṃ dehaṃ pūjayitvā prāṇadhīśūnyavigrahān anyonyatanmayībhūtān pūjayecchivatādṛśe / tatra prāṇāśraye nayāse buddhyā viracite sati śūnyādhiṣṭhānataḥ sarvamekayatnena pūjyate / nyasyedādhāraśaktiṃ tu nābhyadhaścaturaṅgulām dharāṃ surodaṃ tejaśca meyapārapratiṣṭhiteḥ / potarūpaṃ marutkandasvabhāvaṃ viśvasūtraṇāt pratyekamaṅgulaṃ nyasyeccatuṣkaṃ vyomagarbhakam / īṣatsamantādamalamidamāmalasārakam tato daṇḍamanantākhyaṃ kalpayellambikāvadhi / tanmātrādikalāntaṃ tadūrdhve granthirniśātmakaḥ

## tal-a15-p31

source_text: [and]-tatra māyāmaye granthau dharmādharmādyamaṣṭakam / vahniprāgādi māyā hi tatsūtirvibhavastu dhīḥ māyāgrantherūrdhvabhūmau triśūlādhaścatuṣkikām / śuddhavidyātmikāṃ dhyāyecchadanadvayasaṃyutām tacca tattvaṃ sthitaṃ bhāvyaṃ lambikābrahmarandhrayoḥ / prakāśayogo hyatraivaṃ dṛkśrotrarasanādikaḥ dakṣānyāvartato nyasyecchaktīnāṃ navakadvayam / vidyāpadme@tra taccoktamapi prāgdarśyate punaḥ vāmā jyeṣṭhā raudrī kālī kalabalavikarike balamathanī / bhūtadamanī ca manonmanikā śāntā śakracāparuciratra syāt vibhvī jñaptikṛtīcchā vāgīśī jvālinī tathā vāmā / jyeṣṭhā raudrītyetāḥ prāgdalataḥ kāladahanavatsarvāḥ dalakesaramadhyeṣu sūryendudahanatrayam / nijādhipairbrahmaviṣṇuharaiścādhiṣṭhitaṃ smaret māyottīrṇaṃ hi yadrūpaṃ brahmādīnāṃ puroditam / āsanaṃ tvetadeva syānnatu māyāñjanāñjitam rudrordhve ceśvaraṃ devaṃ tadūrdhve ca sadāśivam / nyasyetsa ca mahāpreta iti śāstreṣu bhaṇyate samastatattvavyāptṛtvānmahāpretaḥ prabodhataḥ / prakarṣagamanāccaiṣa līno yannādharaṃ vrajet

## tal-a15-p32

source_text: [and]-vidyāvidyeśinaḥ sarve hyuttarottaratāṃ gatāḥ / sadāśivībhūya tataḥ paraṃ śivamupāśritāḥ ataḥ sadāśivo nityamūrdhvadṛgbhāsvarātmakaḥ / kṛśo meyatvadaurbalyātpreto@ṭṭahasanāditaḥ tasya nābhyutthitaṃ mūrdharandhratrayavinirgatam / nādāntātma smarecchaktivyāpinīsamanojjvalam arātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ tatrāpyaunmanasaṃ trayam / paṅkajānāṃ sitaṃ saptatriṃśadātmedamāsanam atra sarvāṇi tattvāni bhedaprāṇāni yattataḥ / āsanatvena bhinnaṃ hi saṃvido viṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ etānyeva tu tattvāni līnāni parabhairave / tādātmyenātha sṛṣṭāni bhidevārcyatvayojane śrīmadbhairavabodhaikyalābhasvātantryavanti tu / etānyeva tu tattvāni pūjakatvaṃ prayāntyalam pūjakaḥ paratattvātmā pūjyaṃ tattvaṃ parāparam / sṛṣṭatvādaparaṃ tattvajālamāsanatāspadam vidyākalāntaṃ siddhānte vāmadakṣiṇaśāstrayoḥ / sadāśivāntaṃ samanāparyantaṃ matayāmale unmanāntamihākhyātamityetatparamāsanam / arcayitvāsanaṃ pūjyā gurupaṅktistu bhāvivat

## tal-a15-p33

## tal-a15-p34

source_text: [and]-aṅgādi niḥsṛtaṃ pūjyaṃ visphuliṅgātmakaṃ pṛthak / madhyagā kila yā devī saiva sadbhāvarūpiṇī kālasaṃkarṣiṇī ghorā śāntā miśrā ca sarvataḥ / siddhātantre ca saikārṇā parā devīti kīrtitā parā tu mātṛkā devī mālinī madhyagoditā / madhye nyasyetsūryaruciṃ sarvākṣaramayīṃ parām tasyāḥ śikhāgre tvaikārṇāṃ tasyāścāṅgādikaṃ tviti / tato viśvaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ pūjitaṃ dakṣiṇottare syādeva pūjitaṃ tena sakṛnmadhye prapūjayet / śrīdevyāyāmale coktaṃ yāge ḍāmarasaṃjñite nāsāgre trividhaṃ kālaṃ kālasaṃkarṣiṇī sadā / mukhasthā śvāsaniḥśvāsakalanī hṛdi karṣati pūrakaiḥ kumbhakairdhatte grasate recakena tu / kālaṃ saṃgrasate sarvaṃ recakenotthitā kṣaṇāt icchāśaktiḥ parā nāmnā śaktitritayabodhinī / yājyā karṣati yatsarvaṃ kālādhāraprabhañjanam iha kila dṛkkarmecchāḥ śiva uktāstāstu vedyakhaṇḍanake / sthūle sūkṣme kramaśaḥ sakalapralayākalau bhavataḥ śuddhā eva tu suptā jñānākalatāṃ gatāḥ prabuddhāstu / pravibhinnakatipayātmakavedyavido mantra ucyante

## tal-a15-p35

source_text: [and]-bhinne tvakhile vedye mantreśāstanmaheśāstu / bhinnābhinne tadiyān suśivānto@dhvoditaḥ prete tā eva galati bhedaprasare kramaśo vikāsamāyāntyaḥ / anyonyāsaṃkīrṇāstvarātrayaṃ galitabhedikāstu tataḥ padmatrayyaunmanasī tadidaṃ syādāsanatvena / tā evānyonyātmakabhedāvacchedanājihāsutayā kila śaktitadvadādiprabhidā pūjyatvamāyātāḥ / bhedagalanādyakoṭerārabhya yato nijaṃ nijaṃ rūpam bibhrati tāstu tritvaṃ tāsāṃ sphuṭameva lakṣyeta / saṃbhāvyavedyakāluṣyayogato@nyonyalabdhasaṃkarataḥ prāk prasphuṭaṃ tribhāvaṃ nāgacchannatra tu tathā na / anyonyātmakabhedāvacchedanakalanasaṃgrasiṣṇutayā / svātantryamātrasārā saṃvitsā kālakarṣiṇī kathitā saiva ca bhūyaḥ svasmātsaṃkarṣati kālamiha bahiṣkurute / saṃkarṣiṇīti kathitā mātṛṣveteṣu sadbhāvaḥ tattvaṃ sattā prāptirmātṛṣu meyo@nayā saṃśca / viśvajananīṣu śaktiṣu paramārtho hi svatantratāmātram eṣaṇavidikriyātmakametatpūjyaṃ yato@navacchinnam / yasminsarvāvacchedadiśo@pi syuḥ samākṣiptāḥ avikalpamiha na yāti hi pūjyatvaṃ naca vikalpa ekatra / bahavo dharmāstasmād yo dharmastāvato dharmān

## tal-a15-p36

source_text: [and]-ākṣipati tatra rūḍhaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭo@dharasthitāstvanye / iti bhairavaparapūjātattvaṃ śrīḍāmare mahāyāge svayameva suprasannaḥ śrīmān śaṃbhurmamādikṣat / bāhyayāge tu padmānāṃ tritaye@pi prapūjayet astrāntaṃ parivāraughamiti no daiśikāgamaḥ / agnīśarakṣovāyvantadikṣu vidyāṅgapañcakam śaktyaṅgāni śivāṅgāni tathaivātra punardvaye / astraṃ nyasyeccaturdikkaṃ madhye locanasaṃjñakam patrāṣṭake@ṣṭakayugamaghorādeḥ svayāmalam / tathā dvādaśakaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ catuṣkaṃ miśritaṃ dviśaḥ sarvaśo dviguṇādītthamāvṛtitvena pūjayet / lokapālāṃstataḥ sāstrānsvadikṣu daśasu kramāt itthaṃ triśūlaparyantadevītādātmyavṛttitaḥ / tiṣṭhannatrārpayanviśvaṃ tarpayeddevatāgaṇam tato japaṃ prakurvīta pratimantraṃ dvipañcadhā / ekaikasya tryātmakatvādabhedāccāpi sarvaśaḥ nābhihṛtkaṇṭhatālūrdhvakuṇḍe jvalanavatsmaran / mantracakraṃ tatra viśvaṃ jvahvansaṃpādayeddhutim dīkṣākarmaṇi kartavye dīkṣāṃ yenādhvanā guruḥ / cikīrṣurdeha evādau bhūyastaṃ mukhyato@rpayet

## tal-a15-p37

source_text: [and]-dvādaśāntamidaṃ prāgraṃ triśūlaṃ mūlataḥ smaran / devīcakrāgragaṃ tyaktakramaḥ khecaratāṃ vrajet mūlādhārāddviṣaṭkāntavyomāgrāpūraṇātmikā / khecarīyaṃ khasaṃcārasthitibhyāṃ khāmṛtāśanāt amuṣmācchāmbhavācchūlāddhrāsayeccaturaṅgulam / śākte tato@pyāṇave tattriśūlatritayaṃ sthitam tattriśūlatrayordhvordhvadevīcakrārpitātmakaḥ / kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate kiṃ vā na vetti na karoti vā ekaikāmathavā devīṃ mantraṃ vā padmagaṃ yajet / yāmalaikyāṅgavaktrādisadasattāvikalpataḥ itthaṃ prāṇādvyomapadaparyantaṃ cetanaṃ nijam / śivībhāvyārcanāyogāttato bāhyaṃ vidhiṃ caret bahiryāgasya mukhyatve siddhyādiparikalpite / antaryāgaḥ saṃskriyāyai hyanyathārcayitā paśuḥ yastu siddhyādivimukhaḥ sa bahiryajati prabhum / antarmahāyāgarūḍhyai tayaivāsau kṛtārthakaḥ kṛtvāntaryāgamādāya dhānyādyastreṇa mantritam / dikṣu kṣipedvighnanude saṃhṛtyaiśīṃ diśaṃ nayet nirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca tāḍanāpyāyane tathā / viguṇṭhanaṃ ca saṃskārāḥ sādhārāstriśiromate

## tal-a15-p39

source_text: [and]-gandhapuṣpopahārādyairvidhinā mantrapūrvakam / tataḥ śiṣyo@sikalaśīhasto dhārāṃ prapātayan guruṇā kumbhahastenānuvrajyo vadatā tvidam / bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye sāvadhānena karmāntaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śivājñayā / tryakṣare nirṛtiprāye nāmni bhoḥśabdamekakam apāsayedyato mantraśchandobaddho@yamīritaḥ / tata aiśyāṃ diśi sthāpyaḥ sa kumbho vikiropari dakṣiṇe cāstravārdhānī sthāpyā kumbhasya sāṃpratam / kumbhasthāmbusamāpattivṛṃhitaṃ mantravṛndakam tejomātrātmanā dhyātaṃ sarvamāpyāyayedvidhim / ataḥ kumbhe mantragaṇaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūjayedguruḥ pūrveṇa vidhināstraṃ ca karkaryāṃ vighnanudyajet / madhyegṛhaṃ tato gandhamaṇḍale pūjayedguruḥ trikaṃ yāmalataikyābhyāmekaṃ vā mantradaivatam / agnikāryavidhānāya tataḥ kuṇḍaṃ prakalpayet śuddhamantrādisaṃjalpasaṃkalpotthamapūrvakam / śivasya yā kriyāśaktistatkuṇḍamiti bhāvanāt paramaḥ khalu saṃskāro vināpyanyaiḥ kriyākramaiḥ / evaṃ dehe sthaṇḍile vā liṅge pātre jale@nale

## tal-a15-p40

source_text: [and]-puṣpādiṣu śiśau mukhyaḥ saṃskāraḥ śivatādṛśe / uktaṃ śrīyogasaṃcāre tathāhi parameśinā caturdaśavidhe bhūte puṣpe dhūpe nivedane / dīpe jape tathā home sarvatraivātra caṇḍikā juhoti japati preddhe pūjayedvihasedvrajet / āhāre maithune saiva dehasthā karmakāriṇī tādṛśīṃ ye tu no rūḍhāṃ saṃvittimadhiśerate / akramāttatprasiddhyarthaṃ kramiko vidhirucyate ahaṃ śivo mantramayaḥ saṃkalpā me tadātmakāḥ / tajjaṃ ca kuṇḍavahnyādi śivātmeti sphuṭaṃ smaret ata eva hi tatrāpi dārḍhyādārḍhyāvalokanāt / kriyamāṇe kṛte vāpi saṃskriyālpetarāpivā yathāhi kaścitpratibhādaridro@bhyāsapāṭavāt / vākyaṃ gṛhṇāti ko@pyādau tathātrāpyavabudhyatām ullekhasekakuṭṭanalepacaturmārgamakṣavṛtiparikalanam / staraparidhiviṣṭarasthitisaṃskārā daśāstrataḥ kuṇḍagatāḥ madhyagrahaṇaṃ darbhadvayena kuśasaṃvṛtiśca bhittīnām / prāṅmukharekhātritayordhvarekhikāḥ kuśasamāvṛtiśca bahiḥ śastalatāścaturaśraṃ daśalokeśārcanāsanavidhiśca / sadmāsādanamastrāgnitejasā rakṣaṇaṃ ca kuṇḍasya

## tal-a15-p41

source_text: [and]-bhūmeḥ śivāgnidhṛtyai śaktirvighnāpasāraṇaṃ cārthāḥ / tatastu pūjite kuṇḍe kriyāśaktitayā sphuṭam mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vāpi nyasyetsaṃkalparūpiṇīm / saṃkalpadevyā yatsṛṣṭidhāma tryaśraṃ kriyātmakam jñānaśukrakaṇaṃ tatra triḥ prakṣobhya vinikṣipet / icchātaḥ kṣubhitaṃ jñānaṃ vimarśātmakriyāpade rūḍhaṃ jñatvādipañcāṅgavispaṣṭaṃ jājvalītyalam / tenāṅgapañcakaireva hutiṃ dadyātsakṛtsakṛt janmādyakhilasaṃskāraśuddho@gnistāvatā bhavet / pañcāṅgameva pṛthvyādirūpaṃ kaṭhinatādikāḥ śaktīrdadhadvahnigatāḥ kuryādgarbhādikāḥ kriyāḥ / tato@khilādhvasaddevīcakragarbhāṃ parāparām smaranpūrṇāhutivaśātpūrayedagnisaṃskriyāḥ / tathā mantreśayuksatyasaṃkalpamahasā jvalan vahnistacchivasaṃkalpatādātmyācchivatātmakaḥ / ityetatsaṃskriyātattvaṃ śrīśaṃbhurme nyarūpayat mayāpi darśitaṃ śuddhabuddhayaḥ praviviñcatām / tenātra ye codayanti yathā bālasya saṃskriyā bahnau vahnestathānyatretyanavasthaiva saṃskṛteḥ / te nirutthānavihatā naye@smingurudarśane

source_text: [and]-jāte@gnau saṃskṛte śaive śabdarāśiṃ ca mālinīm / pitarau pūjayitvā svaṃ śuddhaṃ dhāma visarjayet śuddhāgnerbhāgamādāya carvarthaṃ sthāpayetpṛthak / athavāgneḥ śikhāṃ vāmaprāṇenādāya hṛjjuṣā cidagninaikyamānīya kṣipeddakṣeṇa saṃskṛtām / śiva ityabhimānena dṛḍhena hi vilokanam sarvasya saṃskriyā tattvaṃ tattasmai yadyato@malam / navāhutīratho dadyānnavātmasahitena tu śivāgnaye tārapūrvaṃ svāhāntaṃ saṃskriyā bhavet / śivacaitanyasāmānyavyoparūpe@nale tataḥ prāgvadādhāramādheyaṃ devīcakraṃ ca yojayet / sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca saṃpaśyedadhovaktrau kramādguruḥ śivaśaktitayābhyarcyau tathetthaṃ saṃskriyānayoḥ / tattvasaṃdarśanānnānyatsaṃskārasyāsti jīvitam iti vaktuṃ sruvādīśaḥ śrīpūrve na samaskarot / tatastilairmṛgīṃ madhyānāmāṅguṣṭhavaśādguruḥ kṛtvā mūlaṃ tarpayet śatenājyasruvaistathā / aṅgavaktraṃ ṣaḍaṃśena śeṣāṃścāpi daśāṃśataḥ sahasrādikahomo@pi tṛptyai vittānusārataḥ / sati vitte@pi lobhādigrasto bāhyapradhānatām

## tal-a15-p43

source_text: [and]-prathayaṃścidguṇībhāvācchaktipātaṃ na vindati / uktaṃ svacchandatantre taddīkṣito@pi na mokṣabhāk nanu yattasya dīkṣāyāṃ kṛtaṃ karmāsya kiṃ phalam / tatrāhurgamaśāstrajñā vāmāśaktimayāstadā mantrā badhnanti taṃ samyagbhavakārāmahāgṛhe / yā tvanugrāhikā śaktisteṣāṃ sā gurudīpitā śodhayeta svaśāstrasthaniṣkāmollaṅghanakriyām / tata ūrdhvādharanyāsādanyonyaunmukhyasundaram sruksruvaṃ śivaśaktyātmādāyājyāmṛtapūritam / samacittaprāṇatanuraikātmyavidhiyogataḥ vāmaṃ srugdaṇḍagaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sopayāmakam / kaṇṭhādhogaṃ vinikṣipya dṛḍhamāpīḍya yatnavān adhaḥ kuryātsrucaṃ prāṇamūrdhvordhvaṃ saṃniyojayan / yāvaddviṣaṭkaparyante bodhāgnau candracakrataḥ srugagrātparamaṃ hlādi patedamṛtamuttamam / tāvadvahnau mantramukhe vauṣaḍantāṃ hutiṃ kṣipet ya ūrdhve kila saṃbodhaḥ kuṇḍe sa pratibimbitaḥ / vahniḥ prāṇaḥ sruksruvau ca snehaḥ saṃkalpacidrasaḥ itthaṃ jñātvāditaḥ kuṇḍasruksruvājyamanūnbhṛśam / dvādaśāntavibodhāgnau ruddhvā pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet

## tal-a15-p44

source_text: [and]-yathā yathā hi gaganamutpatetkalahaṃsakaḥ / jale binbaṃ bruḍatyasya tathetyatrāpyayaṃ vidhiḥ svābhāvikaṃ sthiraṃ caiva dravaṃ dīptaṃ calaṃ nabhaḥ / māyā bindustathaivātmā nādaḥ śaktiḥ śivastathā itthaṃ vyāpyavyāpakato vibhedyābhyantarāntam / tadadhaḥsthāni pṛthvyādimūlāntāni tathā pumān avidyārāganiyatikālamāyākalāstathā / aṇurvidyā tadīśeśau sādākhyaṃ śaktikuṇḍalī vyāpinī samanaunmanyaṃ tato@nāmani yojayet / recakastho madhyanāḍīsandhividgururityadaḥ proktaṃ traiśirase tantre parayojanavarṇane / tataḥ prāksthāpitānyastamantrasaṃskṛtavahninā caruḥ sādhyo@thavā śiṣyairhomena samakālakaḥ / carau ca vīradravyāṇi laukikānyathavecchayā carusiddhau samastāśca kriyā hṛnmantrayogataḥ / tataścaruṃ samādāya gururājyena pūritām srucaṃ sruvaṃ vā kṛtvaiva bhuktimuktyanusārataḥ / devānāmatha śaktīnāṃ yantrāṇāṃ tu trayaṃ trayam saptamaṃ mātṛsadbhāvaṃ kramādekaikaśaḥ paṭhan / svā ityamṛtavarṇena vahnau hutvājyaśeṣakam

## tal-a15-p45

source_text: [and]-carau hetyagnirūpeṇa juhuyāttatpunaḥ punaḥ / bhojyabhojakacarvagnyoritthamekānusandhitaḥ svāhāpratyavamarśātsyātsamantrādadvayaṃ param / eṣa saṃpātasaṃskāraścarorbhoktā hyadhiṣṭhitaḥ bhogyasya paramaṃ sāraṃ bhogyaṃ narnarti yatnataḥ / samamekānusandhānātpātato bhoktṛbhogyayoḥ anyo@nyatra ca saṃpātātsaṃgamāccetthamucyate / sthaṇḍile kubhbhakarkaryorbhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedayet bhāgenāgnau mantratṛptirdvayaṃ śiṣyātmanoratha / itthaṃ vihitakartavyo vijñāpyeśaṃ tadīritaḥ śaktipātakramācchiṣyānsaṃskartuṃ niḥsaredbahiḥ / tatraiṣāṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca caruṃ daśanamārjanam tasya pātaḥ śubhaḥ prācīsaumyaiśāpyordhvadiggataḥ / aśubho@nyatra tatrāstrahomo@pyaṣṭaśataṃ bhavet netramantritasadvastrabaddhanetrānacañcalān / ananyahṛdayībhūtānbalāditthaṃ nirodhataḥ muktāratnādikusumasaṃpūrṇāñjalikānguruḥ / praveśya sthaṇḍilopāgra upaveśyaiva jānubhiḥ prakṣepayedañjaliṃ taṃ taiḥ śiṣyairbhāvitātmabhiḥ / añjali punarāpūrya teṣāṃ lāghavataḥ paṭam

## tal-a15-p47

source_text: [and]-bāhyāpare parānemau madhyaśūlaparāpare / jvālākule@ruṇe bhrāmyanmātṛpraṇavabhīṣaṇe cintite tu bahirhaste saṃdṛṣṭe samayī bhavet / pāśastobhādyastu sadya uccikramiṣurasya tam prāṇairviyojakaṃ mūrdhni kṣipetsaṃpūjya tadbahiḥ / anena śivahastena samayī bhavati sphuṭam tasyaiva bhāvividhivattattvapāśaviyojane / putrakatvaṃ sa ca pare tattve yojyastu daiśikaiḥ sa eva mantrajātijño japahomāditattvavit / nirvāṇakalaśenādau tata īśvarasaṃjñinā abhiṣiktaḥ sādhakaḥ syādbhogānte@sya pare layaḥ / etairguṇaiḥ samāyukto dīkṣitaḥ śivaśāsane catuṣpātsaṃhitābhijñastantrāṣṭādaśatatparaḥ / daśatantrātimārgajña ācāryaḥ sa vidhīyate pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā nirvāṇānte@sya yojanām / abhiṣekavidhau kuryādācāryasya gurūttamaḥ etairvākyairidaṃ coktaṃ samayī rājaputravat / sarvatraivādhikārī syātputrakādipadatraye putrako daiśikatve tu tulyayojaniko bhavet / adhikārī sa na punaḥ sādhane bhinnayojane

## tal-a15-p48

source_text: [and]-etattantre samayyādikramādāptottarakriyaḥ / ācāryo na punarbauddhavaiṣṇavādiḥ kadācana evaṃ prasaṅgānnirṇītaṃ prakṛtaṃ tu nirūpyate / śivahastavidhiṃ kṛtvā tena saṃpluṣṭapāśakam śiṣyaṃ vidhāya viśrāntiparyantaṃ dhyānayogataḥ / tataḥ kumbhe@strakalaśe vahnau svātmani taṃ śiśum praṇāmaṃ kārayetpaścādbhūtamātṛbaliṃ kṣipet / tataḥ śaṃkaramabhyarcya śayyāmastrābhimantritām kṛtvāsyāṃ śiṣyamāropya nyastamantraṃ vidhāya ca / śiṣyahṛccakraviśrāntiṃ kṛtvā taddvādaśāntagaḥ bhavetkṣīṇakalājālaḥ svaradvādaśakodayāt / tataḥ praveśapracitakalāṣoḍaśakojjvalaḥ saṃpūrṇasvātmaciccandro viśrāmyeddhṛdaye śiśoḥ / svayaṃ vyutthānaparyantaṃ dvādaśāntaṃ tato vrajet punarviśecca hṛccakramitthaṃ nidrāvidhikramaḥ / āyātanidraḥ śiṣyo@sau nirmalau śaśibhāskarau hṛccakre pratisaṃdhatte balātpūrṇakṛśātmakau / haṭhanirmalacandrārkaprakāśaḥ satyamīkṣate svapnaṃ bhāviśubhānyatvasphuṭībhāvanakovidam / uktaṃ ca pūrṇāṃ ca kṛśāṃ dhyātvā dvādaśagocare

## tal-a15-p49

source_text: [and]-praviśya hṛdaye dhyāye tsuptaḥ svācchandyamāpnuyāt / āyātanidre ca śiśau gururabhyarcya śaṅkaram caruṃ bhuñjīta sasakhā tato@dyāddantadhāvanam / svapyācca mantraraśmīddhahṛccakrārpitamānasaḥ prātarguruḥ kṛtāśeṣanityo@bhyarcitaśaṃkaraḥ / śiṣyātmanoḥ svapnadṛṣṭāvarthau vitte balābalāt svadṛṣṭaṃ balavannānyatsaṃbodhodrekayogataḥ / bodhasāmye punaḥ svapnasāmyaṃ syādguruśiṣyayoḥ devāgnigurutatpūjākāraṇopaskarādikam / hṛdyā strī madyapānaṃ cāpyāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam raktapānaṃ śiraśchedo raktaviṇmūtralepanam / parvatāśvagajaprāyahṛdyayugyādhirohaṇam yatprītyai syādapi prāyastattacchubhamudāhṛtam / taṃ khyāpayettuṣṭivṛddhyai hlādo hi paramaṃ phalam ato@nyadaśubhaṃ tatra homo@ṣṭaśatako@strataḥ / aśubhaṃ nāśubhamiti śiṣyebhyo kathayedguruḥ rūḍhāṃ hi śaṅkāṃ vicchettuṃ yatnaḥ saṃghaṭate mahān / yeṣāṃ tu śaṅkāvilayasteṣāṃ svapnavaśotthitam śubhāśubhaṃ na kiṃcitsyāt syuścetthaṃ citratāvaśāt / sphuṭaṃ paśyati sattvātmā rājaso liṅgamātrataḥ

## tal-a15-p50

source_text: [and]-na kiṃcittāmasastasya sukhaduḥkhācchubhāśubham / nanvatra tāmaso nāma kathaṃ yogyo vidhau bhavet maiva mā vigrahaṃ kaścitkvacitkasyāpi vai guṇaḥ / sarvasāttvikaceṣṭo@pi bhojane yadi tāmasaḥ kiṃ tataḥ so@dhamaḥ kivāpyutkṛṣṭastadviparyayaḥ / āyātaśaktipāto@pi dīkṣito@pi guṇasthiteḥ vicitrātmā bhavedeva mukhye tvarthe samāhitaḥ / tato guruḥ śiśormantrapūrvakaṃ devatārcanam deśayetsa ca tatkuryātsaṃskuryāttaṃ tato guruḥ / hṛdādicakraṣaṭkasthānbrahmādīn ṣaṭ samāhitaḥ spṛśecchiśoḥ prāṇavṛttyā pratyekaṃ cāṣṭa saṃskriyāḥ / hṛdayādidviṣaṭkāntaṃ bodhasparśapavitritaḥ āhārabījabhāvādidoṣadhvaṃsādbhaveddvijaḥ / vasuvedākhyasaṃskārapūrṇa itthaṃ dvijaḥ sthitaḥ garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmanto jātakarma ca / nāma niṣkrāmaṇaṃ cānnapraśaścūḍā tathāṣṭamī vratabandhaiṣṭike maujjībhautike saumikaṃ kramāt / godānamiti vedendusaṃskriyā brahmacaryataḥ pratyudvāhaḥ pañcadaśaḥ sapta pākamakhāstvataḥ / aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇī śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrāyaṇīdvayam

## tal-a15-p51 (15.501-15.510)
literal_gloss:
na kiṃcittāmasastasya sukhaduḥkhācchubhāśubham / nanvatra tāmaso nāma kathaṃ yogyo vidhau bhavet maiva mā vigrahaṃ kaścitkvacitkasyāpi vai guṇaḥ / sarvasāttvikaceṣṭo@pi bhojane yadi tāmasaḥ kiṃ tataḥ so@dhamaḥ kivāpyutkṛṣṭastadviparyayaḥ / āyātaśaktipāto@pi dīkṣito@pi guṇasthiteḥ vicitrātmā bhavedeva mukhye tvarthe samāhitaḥ / tato guruḥ śiśormantrapūrvakaṃ devatārcanam deśayetsa ca tatkuryātsaṃskuryāttaṃ tato guruḥ / hṛdādicakraṣaṭkasthānbrahmādīn ṣaṭ samāhitaḥ spṛśecchiśoḥ prāṇavṛttyā pratyekaṃ cāṣṭa saṃskriyāḥ / hṛdayādidviṣaṭkāntaṃ bodhasparśapavitritaḥ āhārabījabhāvādidoṣadhvaṃsādbhaveddvijaḥ / vasuvedākhyasaṃskārapūrṇa itthaṃ dvijaḥ sthitaḥ garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmanto jātakarma ca / nāma niṣkrāmaṇaṃ cānnapraśaścūḍā tathāṣṭamī vratabandhaiṣṭike maujjībhautike saumikaṃ kramāt / godānamiti vedendusaṃskriyā brahmacaryataḥ pratyudvāhaḥ pañcadaśaḥ sapta pākamakhāstvataḥ / aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇī śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrāyaṇīdvayam

## tal-a15-p51

source_text: [and]-caitrī cāśvayujī paścāt saptaiva tu havirmakhāḥ / ādheyamagnihotraṃ ca paurṇamāsaḥ sadarśakaḥ cāturmāsyaṃ paśūdbandhaḥ sautrāmaṇyā saha tvamī / agniṣṭomo@tipūrvo@tha sokyyaḥ ṣoḍaśivājapau āptoryāmātirātrau ca saptaitāḥ somasaṃsthitāḥ / hiraṇyapādādimakhaḥ sahasreṇa samāvṛtaḥ aṣṭatriṃśastvaśvamedho gārhasthyamiyatā bhavet / vānasthyapārivrājye ca catvāriṃśadamī matāḥ dayā kṣamānasūyā ca śuddhiḥ satkṛtimaṅgale / akārpaṇyāspṛhe cātmaguṇāṣṭakamidaṃ smṛtam mekhalā daṇḍamajinatryāyuṣe vahnyupāsanam / saṃdhyā bhikṣeti saṃskārāḥ sapta sapta vratāni ca bhauteśapāśupatye dve gāṇeśaṃ gāṇapatyakam / unmattakāsidhārākhyaghṛteśāni caturdaśa ete tu vratabandhasya saṃskārā aṅginaḥ smṛtāḥ / pārivrājyasya garbhe syādantyeṣṭiriti saṃskṛtaḥ dvijo bhavettato yogyo rudrāṃśāpādanāya saḥ / etānprāṇakrameṇaiva saṃskārānyojayedguruḥ athavāhutiyogena tilādyairmantrapūrvakaiḥ / praṇavo hṛdayaṃ nāma śodhayāmyagnivallabhā

## tal-a15-p52

source_text: [and]-evaṃ krameṇa mūrdhādyairaṅgairatatpunaḥ punaḥ / yataściddharma evāsau śāntyādyātmā dvijanmatā tena rudratayā saṃvittatkrameṇaiva jāyate / yathā hemādidhātūnāṃ pāke kramavaśādbhavet rajatādi tathā saṃvitsaṃskāre dvijatāntare / yonirna kāraṇaṃ tatra śāntātmā dvija ucyate muninā mokṣadharmādāvetacca pravivecitam / mukuṭādiṣu śāstreṣu devenāpi nirūpitam saṃvido dehasaṃbhedātsadṛśātsadṛśodayāt / bhūmābhiprāyataḥ smārte dvijanmā dvijayoḥ sutaḥ antyajātīyadhīvādijananījanmalābhataḥ / utkṛṣṭacittā ṛṣayaḥ kiṃ brāhmaṇyena bhājanam ata evārthasattattvadeśinyasminna diśyate / rahasyaśāstre jātyādisamācāro hi śāmbhave pāśavāni tu śāstrāṇi vāmaśaktyātmakānyalam / sṛṣṭyāṃcisiddhaye śaṃbhoḥ śaṅkātatphalakḷptaye āpāditadvijatvasya dvādaśānte nijaikyataḥ / sparśamātrānna viśrāntyā jhaṭityevāvarohataḥ rudrāṃśāpādanaṃ yena samayī saṃskṛto bhavet / adhītau śravaṇe nityaṃ pūjāyāṃ gurusevane

## tal-a15-p53

source_text: [and]-samayyadhikṛto@nyatra guruṇā vibhumarcayet / tamāpāditarudrāṃśaṃ samayān śrāvayedguruḥ aṣṭāṣṭakātmakāndevyāyāmalādau nirūpitān / avādo@karaṇaṃ gūḍhiḥ pūjā tarpaṇabhāvane hananaṃ mohanaṃ ceti samayāṣṭakamaṣṭadhā / svabhāvaṃ mantratantrāṇāṃ samayācāramelakam asatpralāpaṃ paruṣamanṛtaṃ nāṣṭadhā vadet / aphalaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ hiṃsāṃ paradārābhimarśanam garvaṃ dambhaṃ bhūtaviṣavyādhitantraṃ nacācaret / svaṃ mantramakṣasūtraṃ ca vidyāṃ jñānasvarūpakam samācārānguṇānkleśānsiddhiliṅgāni gūhayet / guruṃ śāstraṃ devavahnī jñānavṛddhāṃstriyo vratam guruvargaṃ yathāśaktyā pūjayedaṣṭakaṃ tvidam / dīnānkliṣṭānpitṝnkṣetrapālānprāṇigaṇān khagān śmāśānikaṃ bhūtagaṇaṃ dehadevīśca tarpayet / śivaṃ śaktiṃ tathātmānaṃ mudrāṃ mantrasvarūpakam saṃsārabhuktimuktīśca guruvaktrāttu bhāvayet / rāgaṃ dveṣamasūyāṃ ca saṃkocerṣyābhimānitāḥ samayapratibhettṝṃstadanācārāṃśca ghātayet / paśumārgasthitānkrūrāndveṣiṇaḥ piśunāñjaḍān

## tal-a15-p54

source_text: [and]-rājñaścānucarānpāpānvighnakartṝṃśca mohayet / śākinyaḥ pūjanīyāśca tāścetthaṃ śrīgamoditāḥ sāhasaṃ dviguṇaṃ yāsāṃ kāmaścaiva caturguṇaḥ / lobhaścāṣṭaguṇastāsāṃ śaṅkyaṃ śākinya ityalam kulāmnāyasthitā vīradravyabāhyāstu ye na taiḥ / paśubhiḥ saha vastavyamiti śrīmādhave kule devatācakragurvagniśāstraṃ sāmyātsadārcayet / aniveditametebhyo na kiṃcidapi bhakṣayet etaddravyaṃ nāpaharedguruvargaṃ prapūjayet / sa ca tadbhrātṛbhāryātukprāyo vidyākṛto bhavet na yonisaṃbandhakṛto laukikaḥ sa paśuryataḥ / tasyābhiṣvaṅgabhūmistu gurvārādhanasiddhaye arcyo na svamahimnā tu tadvargo guruvatpunaḥ / gurornindāṃ na kurvīta tasyai hetuṃ nacācaret naca tāṃ śṛṇuyānnainaṃ kopayennāgrato@sya ca / vinājñayā prakurvīta kiṃcittatsevanādṛte laukikālaukikaṃ kṛtyaṃ krodhaṃ krīḍāṃ tapo japam / gurūpabhuktaṃ yatkiṃcicchayyāvastrāsanādikam nopabhuñjīta tatpadbhyāṃ na spṛśetkiṃtu vandayet / śrīmattraiśirase@pyuktaṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ

## tal-a15-p55

## tal-a15-p56

source_text: [and]-tasya tanniṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ samayena ca laṅghyate / saiddhāntikārpitaṃ caṇḍīyogyaṃ dravyaṃ vivarjayet śākinīvācakaṃ śabdaṃ na kadācitsamuccaret / striyaḥ pūjyā virūpāstu vṛddhāḥ śilpopajīvikāḥ antyā vikāritāṅgyaśca veśyāḥ svacchandaceṣṭitāḥ / tathāca śrīgame proktaṃ pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ nirācārāḥ sarvabhakṣyā dharmādharmavivarjitāḥ / svacchandagāḥ palāśinyo lampaṭā devatā iva veśyāḥ pūjyāstadgṛhaṃ ca prayāgo@tra yajetkramam / strīṣu tannācaretkicidyena tābhyo jugupsate ato na nagnāstāḥ paśyennacāpi prakaṭastanīḥ / vṛddhāyāḥ saṃsthitāyā vā na jugupseta mudrikām vaikṛtyaṃ tatra saurūpyaṃ melakaṃ na prakāśayet / devamūrtiṃ śūnyatanuṃ pūjayettripathādiṣu sarvaparvasu sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ / pūjā guroranadhyāyo melake lobhavarjanam na jugupseta madyādi vīradravyaṃ kadācana / na nindedatha vandeta nityaṃ tajjoṣiṇastathā upadeśāya na doṣā hṛdayaṃ cenna vidviṣet / vijātīyavikalpāṃśotpuṃsanāya yateta ca

## tal-a15-p57

source_text: [and]-guroḥ śāstrasya devīnāṃ nāma mantre yatastataḥ / arcāto@nyatra noccāryamāhūtaṃ tarpayettataḥ āgatasya ca mantrasya na kuryāttarpaṇaṃ yadi / haratyardhaśarīraṃ tadityūce bhagavānyataḥ śrīmadūrmau ca devīnāṃ vīrāṇāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ na vai / prathayenna jugupseta vadennādravyapāṇikaḥ śrīpūrvaṃ nāma vaktavyaṃ gurordravyakareṇa ca / gurvādīnāṃ na laṅghyā ca chāyā na tairthikaiḥ saha jalpaṃ kurvansvaśāstrārthaṃ vadennāpica sūcayet / nityādviśeṣapūjāṃ ca kuryānnaimittike vidhau tato@pi madhye varṣasya tato@pi hi pavitrake / anyastamantro nāsīta sevyaṃ śāstrāntaraṃ ca no aprarūḍhaṃ hi vijñānaṃ kampetetarabhāvanāt / gṛhopaskaraṇāstrāṇi davatāyāgayogataḥ arcyānīti na padbhyāṃ vai spṛśennāpi vilaṅghyet / guruvarge gṛhāyāte viśeṣaṃ kaṃcidācaret dīkṣitānāṃ na nindādi kuryādvidveṣapūrvakam / upadeśāya no doṣaḥ sa hyavidveṣapūrvakaḥ na vaṣṇavādikādhaḥsthadṛṣṭibhiḥ saṃvasedalam / sahabhojanaśayyādyarnaiṣāṃ prakaṭayetsthitim

## tal-a15-p58

source_text: [and]-uktaṃ śrīṃmādhavakule śāsanāntarasaṃsthitān / vedoktiṃ vaiṣṇavoktiṃ ca tairuktaṃ varjayetsadā akulīneṣu saṃparkāttatkulātpatanādbhayam / ekapātre kulāmnāye tasmāttānparivarjayet pramādācca kṛte sakhye goṣṭhyāṃ cakraṃ tu pūjayet / śrīmadūrmau ca kathitamāgamāntarasevake gurvantararate mūḍhe devadravyopajīvake / śaktihiṃsākare duṣṭe saṃparkaṃ naiva kārayet na vikalpena dīkṣādau vrajedāyatanādikam / uktāsthāśithilatve yannimittaṃ naiva taccaret śāsanasthānpurājātyā na paśyennāpyudīrayet / naca vyavaharetsarvāñchivābhedena kevalam sadvidyaiḥ sākamāsīta jñānadīptyai yateta ca / nāsaṃskṛtāṃ vrajettajjaṃ viphalatvaṃ nacānayet melakārdhaniśācaryā janavarjaṃ ca tannahi / māṃsādidāhagandhaṃ ca jighreddevīpriyo hyasau gurvājñāṃ pālayansarvaṃ tyajenmantramayo bhavet / śāstrapūjājapadhyānavivekatadupakriyāḥ akurvanniṣphalāṃ naiva ceṣṭeta trividhāṃ kriyām / mantratantrairna vādaṃ ca kuryānno bhakṣayedviṣam

## tal-a15-p59

source_text: [and]-samayānāṃ vilope ca guruṃ pṛcchedasannidhau / tadvargaṃ nijasantānamanyaṃ tasyāpyasaṃnidhau tenoktamanutiṣṭhecca nirvikalpaṃ prayatnataḥ / yataḥ śāstrādisaṃbodhatanmayīkṛtamānasaḥ śiva eva gururnāsya vāgasatyā viniḥsaret / śivasya svātmasaṃskṛtyai prahvībhāvo guroḥ punaḥ hlādāyetyubhayārthāya tattuṣṭiḥ phaladā śiśoḥ / gurvāyattaikasiddhirhisamayyapi vibodhabhāk tadbodhabahumānena vidyādgurutamaṃ gurum / ataḥ saṃprāpya vijñānaṃ yo gurau bāhyamānavān nāsau vijñānaviśvasto nāsatyaṃ bhraṣṭa eva saḥ / jñānānāśvastacittaṃ taṃ vacomātreṇa śāstritam bhaktaṃ ca nārcayejjātu hṛdā vijñānadūṣakam / tādṛk ca na guruḥ kāryastaṃ kṛtvāpi parityajet mukhyabuddhyā na saṃpaśyedvaiṣṇavādigatāngurūn / tathāca śrīmadūrmyākhye guroruktaṃ viśeṣaṇam gurvājñā prāṇasaṃdehe nopekṣyā no vikalpyate / kauladīkṣā kaulaśāstraṃ tattvajñānaṃ prakāśitam yenāsau gururityukto hyanye vai nāmadhāriṇaḥ / śrīmadānandaśāstre ca tathaivoktaṃ viśeṣaṇam

## tal-a15-p60 (15.591-15.600)
literal_gloss:
samayānāṃ vilope ca guruṃ pṛcchedasannidhau / tadvargaṃ nijasantānamanyaṃ tasyāpyasaṃnidhau tenoktamanutiṣṭhecca nirvikalpaṃ prayatnataḥ / yataḥ śāstrādisaṃbodhatanmayīkṛtamānasaḥ śiva eva gururnāsya vāgasatyā viniḥsaret / śivasya svātmasaṃskṛtyai prahvībhāvo guroḥ punaḥ hlādāyetyubhayārthāya tattuṣṭiḥ phaladā śiśoḥ / gurvāyattaikasiddhirhisamayyapi vibodhabhāk tadbodhabahumānena vidyādgurutamaṃ gurum / ataḥ saṃprāpya vijñānaṃ yo gurau bāhyamānavān nāsau vijñānaviśvasto nāsatyaṃ bhraṣṭa eva saḥ / jñānānāśvastacittaṃ taṃ vacomātreṇa śāstritam bhaktaṃ ca nārcayejjātu hṛdā vijñānadūṣakam / tādṛk ca na guruḥ kāryastaṃ kṛtvāpi parityajet mukhyabuddhyā na saṃpaśyedvaiṣṇavādigatāngurūn / tathāca śrīmadūrmyākhye guroruktaṃ viśeṣaṇam gurvājñā prāṇasaṃdehe nopekṣyā no vikalpyate / kauladīkṣā kaulaśāstraṃ tattvajñānaṃ prakāśitam yenāsau gururityukto hyanye vai nāmadhāriṇaḥ / śrīmadānandaśāstre ca tathaivoktaṃ viśeṣaṇam

## tal-a15-p60

source_text: [and]-yasmāddīkṣā mantraśāstraṃ tattvajñānaṃ sa vai guruḥ / tiṣṭhedavyaktaliṅgaśca na liṅgaṃ dhārayet kvacit na liṅgibhiḥ samaṃ kaiścitkuryādācāramelanam / kevalaṃ liṅginaḥ pālyā na bībhatsyā virūpakāḥ śrīmadrātrikule coktaṃ mokṣaḥ śaṅkāpahānitaḥ / aśuddhavāsasnayaiṣā mokṣavārtāpi durlabhā na likhenmantrahṛdayaṃ śrīmanmāloditaṃ kila / tadaṅgāduddharenmantraṃ natu lekhe vilekhayet atattve@bhiniveśaṃ ca na kuryātpakṣapātataḥ / jātividyākulācāradehadeśaguṇārthajān grahāngrahānivāṣṭau drāktyajedgahvararśitān / tathā śrīniśicārādau hayatvenopadarśitān brāhmaṇo@haṃ mayā vedaśāstroktādaparaṃ katham / anuṣṭheyamayaṃ jātigrahaḥ paranirodhakaḥ evamanye@pyudāhāryāḥ kulagahvaravartmanā / atatsvabhāve tādrūpyaṃ darśayannavaśe@pi yaḥ svarūpācchādakaḥ so@tra graho graha ivoditaḥ / saṃvitsvabhāve no jātiprabhṛtiḥ kāpi kalpanā rūpaṃ sā tvasvarūpeṇa tadrūpaṃ chādayatyalam / yā kācitkalpanā saṃvittattvasyākhaṇḍitātmanaḥ

## tal-a15-p61

source_text: [and]-saṃkocakāriṇī sarvaḥ sa grahastāṃ parityajet / śrīmadānandaśāstre ca kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā nirapekṣaḥ prabhurvāmo na śuddhyā tatra kāraṇam / devītṛptirmakhe raktamāṃsairno śaucayojanāt dvijāntyajaiḥ samaṃ kāryā carcānte@pi marīcayaḥ / avikārakṛtastena vikalpānnirayo bhavet sarvadevamayaḥ kāyaḥ sarvaprāṇiṣviti sphuṭam / śrīmadbhirnakuleśādyairapyetatsunirūpitam śarīramevāyatanaṃ nānyadāyatanaṃ vrajet / tīrthamekaṃ smarenmantramanyatīrthāni varjayet vidhimenaṃ sukhaṃ jñātvā vidhijālaṃ parityajet / samādhirniścayaṃ muktvā na cānyenopalabhyate iti matvā vidhānajñaḥ saṃmohaṃ parivarjayet / mantrasya hṛdayaṃ muktvā na cānyatparamaṃ kvacit iti matvā vidhānajño mantrajālaṃ parityajet / naivedyaṃ prāśayennadyāstaccheṣaṃ ca jale kṣipet tairbhukte na bhaveddoṣo jalajaiḥ pūrvadīkṣitaiḥ / avayaśpālanīyatvātparattvena saṃgamāt jñānaprāptyabhyupāyatvātsamayāste prakīrtitāḥ / evaṃ saṃśrāvya samayāndevaṃ saṃpūjya daiśikaḥ

## tal-a15-p62

source_text: [and]-visarjayetsvacidvyomni śānte mūrtivilāpanāt / yadi putrakadīkṣāsya na kāryā samanantaram tadābhiṣiñcetsāstreṇa śivakumbhena taṃ śiśum / ātmānaṃ ca tato yasmājjalamūrtirmaheśvaraḥ mantrayuṅnikhilāpyāyī kāryaṃ tadabhiṣecanam / iti samayadīkṣaṇamidaṃ prakāśitaṃ vistarācca saṃkṣepāt
